NUXT_INTTEGRO_API_KEY.description: Create a dedicated API key in Inttegro Studio. Nuxt reads this only from private runtime configuration.

NUXT_DEMO_PRODUCT_ID.description: The active Kora Market Product ID resolved by Nitro at checkout.

NUXT_DEMO_PRICE_ID.description: An active Price ID belonging to the configured Kora Market Product.

NUXT_DEMO_PUBLIC_URL.description: Optional public origin for completion and cancellation URLs, without a trailing slash.
